_status: Yenna's text (docs/medical/measurements.json, merged by scripts/merge_medical.py) under the app's metric keys. Entries with 'app_fix' were changed to match how the app measures; entries with 'draft' are placeholders she has not written yet.
_how_to_read: One entry per metric in thresholds.json (same key). how_to_measure = steps shown in the Learn tab and the daily check; why_check = why this matters in space (one line under the step title in the daily check); can_do_in_space = whether it can be measured on board, with a note on the equipment.

how_to_measure: Put the finger PPG clip on your fingertip.
Sit still and breathe normally for 2 minutes during the daily check.
hr_rest.why_check: A rising resting heart rate is an early sign of stress, fatigue, or illness.
hr_rest.app_fix: Measured with the finger PPG clip during the 2-minute seated check, not a wristband for 3 minutes.

how_to_measure: Put the finger PPG clip on your fingertip.
Sit still and breathe normally for 2 minutes during the daily check.
The app works out your heart rate variability from the beats.
hrv_rmssd.why_check: Heart rate variability shows how well your body recovers from stress and exercise.
hrv_rmssd.app_fix: Measured with the finger PPG clip during the 2-minute seated check, not a chest strap overnight.

how_to_measure: Place the sensor on your index finger.
Wait 15 seconds for the reading to stabilize.
spo2.why_check: Checks if your lungs are moving enough oxygen into your blood.

how_to_measure: Put the finger PPG clip on your fingertip.
Sit still and breathe normally for 2 minutes during the daily check.
The app counts your breaths from the pulse signal.
rr.why_check: High breathing rates can indicate high CO2 in the cabin or an incoming illness.
rr.app_fix: Breathing rate is estimated from the finger PPG signal in the seated check, not a chest strap or wristband.

how_to_measure: Sit still for 2 minutes with the finger PPG clip on.
Stand up and stay standing for 1 minute.
DRAFT: Perform only in gravity environments.
stand_hr_rise.why_check: Tests how well your heart responds to gravity, showing if you are dehydrated or dizzy.

can_do_in_space.note: gravity only (Moon, Mars surface, after landing)

stand_hr_rise.app_fix: The app's stand test is sit 2 minutes then stand 1 minute (not lie down 5 minutes), with the finger PPG clip. It only means something in gravity, so can_do_in_space is false in orbit.

how_to_measure: Wrap the cuff around your bare upper arm.
Keep your arm at heart level and press start.
bp_sys.why_check: Measures the maximum pressure in your blood vessels. Important for tracking fluid shifts.

how_to_measure: Wrap the cuff around your bare upper arm.
Keep your arm at heart level and press start.
bp_dia.why_check: Measures the resting pressure in your blood vessels. Helps check heart health.

how_to_measure: Wear the biometric wristband to bed.
Sync the device in the morning.
sleep_h.why_check: Good sleep is critical for quick thinking, mood, and immune health.

how_to_measure: Open the daily check questions.
Rate your mood from 1 (very low) to 5 (very good).
mood.why_check: Isolation and workload affect your mental health. Tracking helps catch burnout early.
mood.app_fix: The daily check uses a 1-5 scale, not a 1-10 slider.

how_to_measure: Open the daily check questions.
Rate your stress from 1 to 5.
stress.why_check: High stress lowers immunity and makes mistakes more likely.
stress.app_fix: The daily check uses a 1-5 scale, not a 1-10 slider.

body_mass_change_pct.equipment: Space linear acceleration mass measurement device

how_to_measure: Log your resistive and aerobic exercise sessions in the app.
exercise_min_7d.why_check: Daily exercise is the only way to stop severe bone and muscle loss in zero gravity.

how_to_measure: Wear your personal dosimeter at all times.
Scan it weekly at the base station.
radiation_total_msv.why_check: Tracks your exposure to space radiation to keep you below dangerous lifetime limits.

how_to_measure: Place the thermometer in your ear.
Press the button and wait for the beep.
temp_c.why_check: A fever means your body is fighting an infection. Spaceflight can slightly raise normal body temp.

how_to_measure: Wash your hands.
Use the lancet to prick your finger.
Apply a drop of blood to the test strip.
glucose_mmol.why_check: Checks your blood sugar levels. Spaceflight can change how your body processes sugar.

how_to_measure: Start the 3-minute reaction test in the daily check.
Press the space bar or tap as fast as you can when the target appears.
The app takes the median of your reaction times.
pvt_median_ms.why_check: Measures your reaction time to ensure you are alert enough for critical tasks.
pvt_median_ms.app_fix: The app's own reaction test is 3 minutes (not a separate PVT app); the result is the median reaction time.

how_to_measure: Counted automatically during the 3-minute reaction test.
A lapse is a reaction of 355 ms or slower, or no reaction.
The app shows lapses as a percentage of all targets (lapse rate, %).
pvt_lapse_rate_pct.why_check: Tracks how many times you zoned out or reacted too slowly. High lapses mean severe fatigue.
pvt_lapse_rate_pct.app_fix: The app reports a lapse RATE in % (lapses / targets), with a lapse = 355 ms or slower (same rule as the CSA PRET reference group), not a lapse count.

how_to_measure: Scan barcode of each food/beverage package using ISS FIT tablet scanner prior to consumption.
Enter portion percentage consumed (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) and log additional water rehydration volume.
Submit daily dietary log to synchronize macronutrient, sodium, and caloric totals with Mission Control.
calories_pct.why_check: Anorexia of spaceflight and high operational tempo often result in chronic negative energy balance, accelerating muscle and bone degradation.

can_do_in_space.note: Electronic food log (ISS FIT app) & barcode scanner

how_to_measure: Power on handheld/portable optical CO2 sensor or query station ECLSS MCA telemetry channel.
Take ambient ppCO2 readings at crew breathing height across multiple station modules/sleep cabins.
Verify local ppCO2 is below 2.0 mmHg; verify adequate ventilation flow and cabin fan operation.
co2_mmhg.why_check: In microgravity, absence of natural thermal convection causes CO2 accumulation around crew heads, triggering headaches and visual impairment.

can_do_in_space.note: ECLSS Major Constituent Analyzer (MCA) & portable sensor

how_to_measure: Wear active personal dosimeter (APD) on operational flight suit continuously during duty hours.
Perform weekly optical/digital readout and dock APD with station radiation console.
Inspect passive dosimeter badge (CPD) position and verify real-time dose rate alarms (<1.0 mSv/day).
radiation_msv.why_check: Space radiation outside Earth's magnetosphere produces cumulative DNA double-strand breaks, cancer risks, and acute radiation sickness risk.

can_do_in_space.note: Crew Passive Dosimeter (CPD) & Active Personal Dosimeter (APD)
